title: Mind in Motion Older Adults Walking Over Uneven Terrain
description: This dataset comprises high-density dual-layer electroencephalography (EEG), neck electromyography (EMG), inertial measurement unit (IMU) acceleration, and ground reaction force recordings from older adults walking over uneven terrain at varying speeds. Participants completed two trials per condition lasting three minutes each, along with a three-minute seated rest baseline. The dataset includes digitized electrode locations for each participant and represents a comprehensive multimodal neurophysiological and biomechanical assessment of locomotor control in aging.
methods_description: Data collection included high-density dual-layer EEG, neck EMG, IMU acceleration, and ground reaction force measurements. Participants performed two trials of three minutes each for each walking condition (varying speeds and terrain types) plus a three-minute seated rest trial.
